def orientations(points, reflect=True):
    variants=set()
    for mir in ([1,-1] if reflect else [1]):
        for k in range(4):
            arr=[]
            for r,c in points:
                x,y=r,mir*c
                for _ in range(k): x,y=y,-x
                arr.append((x,y))
            mr=min(x for x,y in arr); mc=min(y for x,y in arr)
            variants.add(tuple(sorted((x-mr,y-mc) for x,y in arr)))
    return [list(x) for x in variants]
ors=orientations(pts)
len(ors),ors
